subject: Clarifying Dedicated Commit + Burst Add-on: cooldowns, surge rates, and discount tiers
messages:
From: Aisha Dutta <aisha.dutta@orbitware.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: OrbitWare Procurement <procurement@orbitware.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T08:12:00-04:00
Subject: Questions on Dedicated commit, burst add-on caps and cooldowns

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising. Before we move to procurement, a couple of clarifying questions from our infra and finance teams around the Dedicated offering and the optional burst / autoscaling add-on:

1) If we commit to a 2x V100-equivalent GPU pool (24 vGPU units) as a monthly reserved commit, what's the guaranteed sustained RPS (or tokens/sec) we should plan for? We have mixed request sizes (median 32 tokens, p95 512 tokens).

2) The workbook you shared has a "burst multiplier" line. How do burst limits work operationally — is it a short-term surge (e.g., 2–3x for 60s), or can bursts be sustained for minutes? What are cooldown rules after a burst?

3) Pricing: procurement needs the breakdown for committed vs burst usage. We also need to understand discount thresholds if we do a 12-month commit vs 24-month.

Can you send a succinct addendum we can attach to our SOW describing burst behavior (limits, surge rates, cooldown), pricing per-GB/slot for burst, and the discount schedule?

Attachments: sample traffic profile (we sent this separately).

Best,
Aisha
Infra Lead — OrbitWare
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Dutta <aisha.dutta@orbitware.com>
Cc: OrbitWare Procurement <procurement@orbitware.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Dedicated commit, burst add-on caps and cooldowns

Hi Aisha — thanks for the detailed questions. I pulled together the baseline answers below and attached a short addendum + a pricing workbook for procurement. Quick summary first:

- Sustained throughput for a 2x V100-equivalent pool: conservatively 380–420 tokens/sec for small payloads; for your median/p95 mix we recommend planning around 110k–150k tokens/min sustained (includes KV cache benefits).
- Burst: default burst multiplier is 2.5x sustained capacity, allowed in 60s windows with a rolling 5-minute cooldown. We do offer a burst-extended add-on (surge buffer) to allow higher sustained bursts (up to 4x) for short windows (<=10 minutes) at a premium.
- Pricing: committed capacity priced as a monthly reserved SKU (committed units). Burst usage billed as an add-on with two bands: standard burst (up to 2.5x) included at a low unit rate, extended burst (2.5x–4x) at higher unit rates.

I've attached: OrbitWare_Dedicated_Proposal_v2.pdf (proposal + SOW addendum) and burst-pricing-model.xlsx (workbook with examples using your traffic profile).

If you want, we can model a 12- vs 24-month discount schedule — typical discount bands: 10% at 12-month commit baseline, 16% at 24-month, plus an additional 2–3% for multi-region commitments. I'll confirm internal approvals if you want steeper concession.

Would you prefer that I loop in Marissa (pricing lead) to finalize the discount grid?

Cheers,
Rafael
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: OrbitWare_Dedicated_Proposal_v2.pdf (PDF), burst-pricing-model.xlsx (Excel)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T13:45:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: OrbitWare — discount request and burst-addendum (need approvals)

Marissa / Lauren — forwarding OrbitWare's clarifying questions. They are leaning toward a 2x commit with occasional heavy traffic spikes tied to batch jobs (two windows per day). Procurement wants the burst/cooldown spelled out in the SOW.

Proposed commercial concession I want to float:
- 12-month commit at 10% off published reserved price
- Include standard burst (2.5x up to 60s) at the low add-on rate for free up to 300k tokens/mo of burst consumption as a goodwill credit in Q1 of the contract
- Extended burst (up to 4x) available at 1.6x the standard burst unit price

They may ask for 15%+ off — what's our floor if we bundle a 24-month/region commit and a 20% usage forecast ramp? Also, confirm whether we can change the cooldown from rolling 5m to a fixed 3m in the SOW (they specifically asked if cooldowns could be shortened).

Quick responses appreciated; OrbitWare is on a short procurement timeline.

-Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-02T09:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: OrbitWare — discount request and burst-addendum (need approvals)

Rafael — thanks for the proposal. High level guidance:

1) Discounts: our standard floor for sales-assisted deals is 12% on 12-months and 18% on 24-months for Dedicated reserved capacity. For a 24-month firm commit with a documented ramp (20% YoY usage increase), we can go to 22% but we should require a mid-term usage review and an early-termination clawback schedule.

2) Burst policy: the platform supports both rolling cooldowns and fixed cooldowns; fixed 3m cooldown is acceptable only if we cap extended burst eligibility and include a safety gate (automatic fallback to a compatible lower-capacity model if sustained beyond the burst window). We do not want unlimited 3m cycles without a gate.

3) Commercial packaging: offer the first 3 months of standard burst (2.5x up to 60s) as a credit if they sign a 24-month commit. Extended burst pricing should be staged: 2.5x–3.5x at 1.45x unit price, 3.5x–4x at 1.9x unit price.

Please include the safety gate language and an optional "surge-buffer" addendum that is revokable if the customer consistently exceeds agreed burst budget. I can bless up to 20% off list if they take 24 months + multi-region. Anything deeper would need VP approval.

-M

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Dutta <aisha.dutta@orbitware.com>
Cc: OrbitWare Procurement <procurement@orbitware.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-02T11:38:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Dedicated commit, burst add-on caps and cooldowns

Hi Aisha — thanks for the patience while we pulled internal approvals. Key points for the SOW addendum (short version you can attach to procurement):

1) Sustained throughput guidance (2x V100-equivalent): plan for ~130k tokens/min sustained for mixed median/p95 profile. We will provision KV caching and recommended batching to reach this.

2) Burst behavior:
- Standard burst: up to 2.5x sustained capacity for windows <=60s. Included add-on billing applies but we will credit the first 300k tokens/month of standard burst for customers who sign 12-months; for 24-month signings, we credit the first 3 months of standard burst usage.
- Extended burst (surge-buffer add-on): allows up to 4x sustained capacity for windows <=10 minutes. This is a billable add-on unless you elect to buy the surge-buffer SKU upfront.
- Cooldown: default is rolling 5-minute cooldown. If you require a fixed 3-minute cooldown, we can include that in SOW only if the extended burst is capped and a safety gate is included (automatic fallback to a lower-capacity model or throttling after X consecutive burst windows).

3) Pricing / discounts:
- 12-month commit: 12% off reserved list price; includes 300k tokens/mo standard burst credit for the first contract month unless you take the reduced 12-mo concession where we give 1-month credit.
- 24-month commit: 18% off reserved list; first 3 months standard burst credit; eligible for additional 2–4% for multi-region commit.
- Extended burst: tiered unit multipliers (1.45x for 2.5–3.5x, 1.9x for 3.5–4x) — workbook shows example costs.

4) Safety gates and SLAs: SOW will state that repeated, sustained exceedance of burst budgets triggers an operations review and potential throttle/auto-fallback policy. Latency SLA remains bound to reserved capacity; burst usage best-effort beyond SLA.

Next steps: I can update the PDF addendum to reflect the 24-month / 18% concession and the fixed-3m cooldown language with the safety gate. If that sounds right I will also attach a redlined SOW and a DocuSign link.

Regards,
Rafael
From: Aisha Dutta <aisha.dutta@orbitware.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: OrbitWare Procurement <procurement@orbitware.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-03T16:43:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Questions on Dedicated commit, burst add-on caps and cooldowns

Rafael — this is exactly what procurement needed. OrbitWare is prepared to sign a 24-month committed SKU at 18% off subject to the following:

- Confirm the first 3 months of standard burst (2.5x up to 60s) will be credited in the billing system as a line item.
- Include the fixed 3-minute cooldown in the SOW with the safety gate described. The gate should be: after 3 consecutive burst windows within a 24-hour period, auto-fallback will engage and Redwood will notify OrbitWare and initiate a joint ops review.
- We want the option to purchase the extended burst surge-buffer SKU upfront at a discounted upfront pre-pay rate — please add pricing and a DocuSign option into the addendum.

If you can attach the redline and send the DocuSign link I will route to our legal and procurement. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Aisha
Infra Lead — OrbitWare
Attachments referenced: OrbitWare_Dedicated_Proposal_v2.pdf (SOW addendum), burst-pricing-model.xlsx (cost breakdown)
